findings.recommendation: Measure cartTotal before and after on a large cart (e.g. 100 items, with EXPLAIN on the ANY($1) query) and record the figures, or soften the release note; the task's only verification is `npm test -- cart` and no test or benchmark for cart exists in the repository.
findings.title: The speed claim is not backed by a measurement

findings.evidence:
const ids = [...new Set(items.map((item) => item.productId))];
const rows = await query<PriceRow>("SELECT id, price_cents FROM products WHERE id = ANY($1)", [ids]);
findings.recommendation: The batched query is sized by the cart (one row per distinct product), which is bounded only if carts are capped; the proposal cites "Carts are limited to 100 items by the existing validation", but no such validation is in src/ (server.ts only serves /health). Point to the validation, or cap items in cartTotal's caller.
findings.title: The 100-item cart bound the query relies on is not found in the code
